Hi Gumi, I really like the art you've posted here. So, I knew that I wanted this done in your style. Because it is iconic really.
I would like to request an illustration this sleepy ghost neko character from the Vtuber Sleepybunsu. This character is tired and melancholic, gothic, and she has a dark power within her.
I have posted a pose as reference as well, though that is a general idea and I want you to have full freedom and creative liberty on how the pose flows. I want her to be sitting on top of a tombstone looking up into the starry night. I'd like the background to be the view of the rest of the cemetery behind her, bushes scattered around. Though I want the view of the background to be obscured in darkness. More towards the foreground of the illustration, in front of her, I'd like viscus dark ooze rising from the ground, I have posted a reference. And I would also appreciate it if you added the white and black ghosts in the reference over both of her shoulders.
I am excited to see how you make this come to life.
